headline: Lamar Jackson left stadium in a boot, believed to be day-to-day with ankle injury
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson's day came to an early end due to an ankle injury, but signs continue to show that Jackson avoided any serious damage.

headline: Maye overcomes his two turnovers with 3 TD passes in Patriots' 29-26 win over Bills
summary: — Drake Maye threw three touchdown passes, including Efton Chism’s one-handed catch with 1:50 remaining, and the New England Patriots defeated the Buffalo Bills 29-26 on Sunday.

headline: CeeDee Lamb's 17 catches, go-ahead score power Cowboys
summary: CeeDee Lamb returned to Houston and caught 17 passes for 189 yards, including the game-winning, 12-yard touchdown with 40 seconds to go, as a large number of family members watched from the stands.

headline: Chiefs beat the Raiders 30-27 to move to 4-0 behind Patrick Mahomes and Kenneth Walker III
summary: — Patrick Mahomes remained undefeated at Allegiant Stadium, passing for 225 yards and two touchdowns, and Kenneth Walker III rushed for 177 yards and two TDs to lead the Chiefs to a 30-27 victory over the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday.
